scope: uniform reflected-light black-lift resilience for any future Hwao-authored method-only proposal iteration
simulation_limit: The transforms are deterministic linear-light black-lift presentation stress tests, not a claim about a named projector, room, display, or viewer.

candidate_evidence.finding: Large result headlines, result numbers, and plot silhouettes remain dominant while low-support copy, axes, legends, citations, and provenance weaken first. No structural held gate appears. Uniform black lift cannot authorize or repair the candidate and instead increases its presentation imbalance.

method_only_evidence.finding: Sealed v8 and the pass-7 caption-safe proof preserve the primary method hierarchy and every visually reviewed held gate at the operational 20-percent stress. The caption-safe scene-specific lines remain visible and OCR-detectable through the severe 40-percent characterization. No new pixel correction is evidenced.

operational_acceptance_floor.transform: decode sRGB to linear light; output linear = 0.20 + 0.80 * input linear; encode sRGB
requirements: Every complete RESULT HELD capsule and its words remain visually readable on 7/7 method scenes.
Every pass-7 scene-specific gate line remains visually readable and OCR-detectable on 7/7 scenes.
Large FRAME UNSTATED, RESULT LOCKED, OUTCOMES WITHHELD, and RESULT STATUS HELD boundaries remain primary or paired with the scene-specific top gate.
No scientific qualifier, unresolved boundary, unavailable rung, or interpretation limit is carried only by a low-contrast footer, citation, axis label, or tiny body line.
Direct diagram labels, card borders, line styles, markers, and status columns remain distinguishable without relying on background darkness alone.
Audience-readable citations remain secondary to the science hierarchy but are not intentionally hidden by low contrast.
The held candidate's survival under wash is evidence of continued failure, not a design target or authorization.

severe_stress_characterization.role: diagnostic characterization only; not a mandatory acceptance threshold
severe_stress_characterization.reason: At these transforms the ideal white-to-black contrast is capped at 3.0:1 and 2.333333:1 respectively. They reveal hierarchy order but do not define an assumed real viewing environment.

cumulative_regression_requirements: Keep the pass-7 scene-specific gate lines above the bottom-quarter obstruction zone.
Keep pass-8 direct-label and non-hue redundancy.
Keep every semantic container inside the pass-9 inner-five-percent title-safe rectangle.
Rerun clean, black-lift, grayscale/color-vision, obstruction, crop, and 360p full-sheet plus full-resolution review after any authorized layout change.
Do not satisfy contrast by enlarging or moving content outside the title-safe rectangle, or by removing qualifiers.

disposition.reason: Current sealed-v8 semantics and the pass-7 caption-safe gates pass the operational 20-percent stress. The narrow evidence-backed action is a non-pixel integration acceptance guard, not a cosmetic iteration.

science_blockers_unchanged: No valid post-run independent A3.8 review for the frozen T4 artifact.

integrator_action: Hwao/Fable may apply this operational 20-percent contrast floor cumulatively with the pass-7 caption-safe, pass-8 redundant-encoding, and pass-9 title-safe contracts. This guard is not v9 and changes no sealed pixel.
